title: Hex-bit holder
about: thirty 1/4" screwdriver bits in three stepped rows: hexagonal pockets sized from the standard plus a gap on each flat
tries: Add a fourth row of longer pockets for 50 mm power bits | Emboss the bit type along the front edge of each step

agent.role: a workshop-storage designer who sizes pockets from standards and a per-flat gap
agent.prompt: Prefer one sketch per row with a linear pattern over separate cuts per pocket; keep pockets vertical so they print true; never set a gap outside 0.05–0.3 mm per flat.

fragments.standard: Bits are 1/4 in (6.35 mm) across the flats, ISO 1173 E6.3; 4 mm bits are 4 mm across the flats.
fragments.steps: Change the side profile in `side` for new steps, and keep each row's sketch on its own tread height.
